title: Add audit log events for KMS rotation operations (key version updates + cutover toggles)
author: Kevin Osei
release_notes: Control-plane now emits explicit audit log events for KMS rotation state changes (key version set, dual-read window changes, cutover/rollback toggles). Events include stable names, actor + request context, before/after fields, and correlation IDs for evidence exports.
body: Summary: This PR adds explicit, evidence-friendly audit log events for KMS rotation-related control-plane operations: (1) updating the active key version / key alias target, (2) enabling/disabling dual-read (dual-decrypt) window, (3) toggling cutover flags for encrypt/write path, and (4) rollback toggles to re-enable old key version reads/writes. Motivation: We currently have good runtime logs and some config-change auditing, but rotation reviews (SOC2/ISO + customer security reviews) keep asking for a clear, queryable trail of who changed what/when during rotation. The goal here is to make rotation events first-class in the audit log schema so (a) internal evidence collection is repeatable, (b) customers can export/ingest these events into SIEM, and (c) on-call can quickly correlate incidents with rotation state changes. Scope: Control-plane audit events only (no cryptographic changes; no new KMS calls). Related: ADR-008 (rotation strategy + dual-read/cutover), ENG-4826 (evidence template), audit-log-exporter PR will follow with schema wiring for exports. Event design: - Stable event names (no environment-specific names): kms.rotation.key_version_update, kms.rotation.dual_read_update, kms.rotation.cutover_update, kms.rotation.rollback_initiated. - Common fields: event_version, actor.{type,id,email}, request.{id,ip,user_agent}, resource.{project_id,env,cluster}, correlation_id, change_ticket (optional), before/after payloads with only non-sensitive values. - Explicit redaction: never emit raw key material; only KMS key identifiers/aliases/ARNs and version labels. - Idempotency: repeated requests that result in no effective change emit kms.rotation.noop_change (for evidence completeness; can be filtered). - Failure behavior: emit kms.rotation.change_attempt_failed with error_category (from taxonomy) and sanitized error_message; do not include cloud-provider request IDs unless already considered non-sensitive (we include kms_request_id only when present and approved by Security). Implementation notes: - Added RotationAuditEmitter helper in control-plane config service; it wraps existing audit logger and ensures required fields are present + consistent. - Updated rotation-related handlers (KeyVersionUpdate, DualReadConfigUpdate, CutoverFlagUpdate) to emit before/after events after validation, and an attempt_failed event on validation or persistence errors. - Added a unit test suite to assert event shape stability (golden JSON snapshots) and required tags. - Added dashboards tags (audit_event_name) to make it easy to slice audit throughput vs error. - Added docs in code comments referencing the evidence checklist fields required by GRC. Rollout plan: - Ship behind feature flag audit.kms_rotation_events.enabled default ON in staging, OFF in prod for 24h. - After verifying event volume and no PII leakage in staging, flip ON in prod via config. - Coordinate with audit-log-exporter change (separate PR) so exported schema includes these new events; until then, events are still queryable internally. Testing: - Unit tests: RotationAuditEmitter shapes + redaction checks. - Integration tests: rotation endpoints in staging with flag ON; verified emitted events present in audit log index with correct correlation_id. - Manual: executed a dual-read enable -> cutover -> rollback in staging and exported the event list for Daniel/Olga to confirm evidence sufficiency. Screenshots/queries are attached in the linked Linear task. Notes for reviewers: Please focus on (a) event naming/field stability, (b) redaction coverage, (c) any gaps in actor/request attribution, and (d) whether noop_change should exist or be removed. This PR does not change runtime decrypt/encrypt behavior; it only increases audit coverage for control-plane state transitions.
commits: control-plane/audit: add rotation audit event constants + schema
control-plane/config: emit audit events for key version updates
control-plane/config: emit audit events for dual-read + cutover toggles
tests: add golden snapshots for rotation audit events
docs: inline guidance for evidence mapping + redaction notes
notable_diff_snippets: New event names: kms.rotation.key_version_update, kms.rotation.dual_read_update, kms.rotation.cutover_update, kms.rotation.rollback_initiated
Event payload includes before/after: { active_key_arn, active_key_version, dual_read_enabled, encrypt_write_key_version } with redaction guardrails
review_conversation: Marcus Lin (Security): Can we confirm we never log full key ARNs for customer-managed keys in Private? Some customers consider ARNs sensitive even if not secret. Also please ensure request_context doesn't capture Authorization headers anywhere in audit logger. / Kevin Osei (author): Good call. We currently log key identifiers/ARNs elsewhere in control-plane logs; for audit events I added allowlist-based fields and explicit header stripping. For ARNs: I can switch to logging key alias + last 8 of key ID by default, with an opt-in to log full ARN in hosted/dedicated. Pushing update.

Ethan Park (Platform): The handlers emit audit after persistence; what about the window where DB write succeeds but audit log write fails? We should avoid silent gaps. / Kevin Osei: Agreed. Audit logger is async but we can add a best-effort retry and also emit an internal metric/audit_write_failed counter. Added metric + error log w/ correlation_id; still no blocking path to avoid turning audit into a hard dependency.

Allison Grant (SRE/Observability): Please add event_version and ensure all events include environment/region tags for alerting + dashboards. Also check cardinality on correlation_id. / Kevin Osei: Added event_version=1 to all events, and ensured resource.{env,region,cluster} are populated from request context. correlation_id is already per-request; we don't tag it as a metric label (logs only).

Daniel Carter (GRC/Evidence): For evidence, auditors want a direct mapping between change ticket and rotation events. Can we include change_ticket if provided and document expected format (e.g., Linear ENG-xxxx / Jira CHG-xxxx)? / Kevin Osei: Added optional change_ticket field, sourced from X-Change-Ticket header (validated) and from internal admin UI form. Also added comment with recommended format. Docs PR will reference it explicitly.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash into main by Connor O'Brien. Follow-ups: (1) audit-log-exporter schema update to include these events for customer exports, (2) update rotation runbook to reference event queries and change_ticket usage, (3) confirm Private default for logging key identifiers is alias + truncated ID only.
